title: Gold Bar Salts Sour Apple Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Sour Apple by Gold Bar delivers a bold, punchy take on Green Apple flavour, pairing sharp, tangy notes with a mellow sweetness that gradually unfolds across each puff. The crisp Green Apple profile makes an immediate impact on the tastebuds, followed by a satisfying finish that strikes a clever balance between tart and sweet. Formulated with nicotine salts, this 10ml e-liquid provides a smooth, tactile throat hit with rapid nicotine absorption. Its 50/50 VG/PG ratio is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it especially suitable for use in pod systems, starter kits, and vape pens. Perfect for vapers who enjoy bright, tangy flavours with a clean finish, this Sour Apple Nic Salt from Gold Bar is a refreshing addition to any all-day rotation.
